title: Dow Jones Futures: Stock Market Hits Highs On Iran-Deal Hopes, Nvidia Leads New Buys; ARM Is Earnings Mover
title_zh: 道琼斯期货：伊朗协议希望推动股市触及高位，英伟达引领新买入； ARM 是盈利推动者
summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit new highs on Iran deal hopes. Nvidia leads new buys with Arm a big earnings mover late.
summary_zh: 由于伊朗协议的希望，标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数创下新高。英伟达 (Nvidia) 在新收购中处于领先地位，而 Arm 是后期盈利的重要推动者。

title: Does GameStop's Proposed Acquisition of eBay Make Sense for Its Stock?
title_zh: GameStop 收购 eBay 的提议对其股票有意义吗？
summary: GameStop is looking to acquire a much larger company than itself.
summary_zh: GameStop 正在寻求收购一家比自己大得多的公司。

title: Diversified, Carlyle strike $1.2bn deal for Anadarko Basin portfolio
title_zh: 凯雷多元化收购阿纳达科盆地投资组合 12 亿美元
summary: The assets span approximately 101,000 acres and produce roughly 300mcf/d net of gas equivalent, comprising 55% gas, 30% NGLs and 15% oil.
summary_zh: 这些资产占地约 101,000 英亩，净天然气当量产量约为 300mcf/d，其中包括 55% 的天然气、30% 的 NGL 和 15% 的石油。

title: Update: Market Chatter: US, Iran Close to Agreement That Could End War, Lead to Broader Deal
title_zh: 更新：市场议论：美国和伊朗接近达成协议，结束战争，达成更广泛的协议
summary: (Updates with response from the White House in the seventh paragraph.) The US and Iran are close
summary_zh: （第七段中白宫回应的更新。）美国和伊朗关系密切

title: Diversified Energy Company inks $1.175bn Oklahoma acquisition alongside Carlyle
